changelog:
- Initial release of product-expert-review-enhanced.
- Generates deep product experience reviews for AI tools, SaaS, or consumer software based on website URLs and/or screenshots.
- Structured, evidence-driven analysis across 10 key user experience dimensions.
- Automatically gathers public and competitor context; adapts based on provided materials.
- Reports produced in Chinese by default, formatted for clarity and actionability.
- Optionally uploads reviews to a Feishu doc for easy sharing.
summary: Generate deep product experience reviews for AI tools, agent products, SaaS products, or consumer-facing software based on a website URL, screenshots, or bot...
